summary.name: Anytype
summary.one_liner: Anytype is a local-first note-taking and knowledge management app where notes, tasks, databases and chats are encrypted and stored on your own device.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Anytype as a tool for creating notes, tasks, databases and chats that only the user can access. Data is stored in a vault on the user's device, encrypted locally, with only the user holding the encryption keys. Accounts can be created offline, and the app is said to work without Wi-Fi. Sync between devices is peer-to-peer over local networks, with no server in the middle. Users can store data locally and self-host backups wherever they choose. The page also states that the app runs on iOS and Android with touch and scroll support.
notable: Local, on-device encryption where only the user holds the keys
Peer-to-peer sync on local networks with no server
Offline account creation and offline operation
Open protocols allowing third-party app building
caveats: Page says 'Free to start' but does not detail paid tiers, so the exact pricing model is unclear from this page
Peer-to-peer sync is described for local networks; the page does not explain sync across remote networks
